page.overview:
Who is Suph Rondi?

Suph Rondi was a crewman of the Hephaestus.

Suph Rondi was on his third voyage on the Hephaestus. The suboids went insane, causing Captain Lazeus to seal off the bridge and warn the crew to get to safety. The suboids got into the engines and caused the ship to crash-land on Arrakis, turning the lights out. Hearing screams in the darkness, Rondi hid in a secluded area and waited for a rescue.

Rondi was found by the Prisoner. He told them what had caused the ship to crash and they asked them how they could reach the crago hold. He replied that there was an eye scanner attached to the pentashield, but refused to leave his hiding place due to his fear of the suboids. They asked if there was another way to enter the cargo hold and he told them that Jackson and Addison both had authorization.
